dataset_mount_path_handling.evidence: --data-dir CLI argument and OCEAN_SENTINEL_DATA_DIR env var supported in scripts/train_exp01.py:881-888. TrujilloTileDataset rebases image and mask paths seamlessly to data_root.

manifest_path_handling.evidence: --manifest CLI argument supported, accepts absolute POSIX or relative path to spatial_split_manifest.json.

posix_path_compatibility.evidence: All path manipulations use pathlib.Path with forward slashes. Zero hardcoded Windows drive letters (C:\ or D:\) in dataset or model loaders.

dataloader_configuration.evidence: DataLoader configured with num_workers=4, pin_memory=True, persistent_workers=True. rasterio.open is strictly scoped inside __getitem__ to eliminate file descriptor leaks across worker processes.

model_reconstruction.evidence: ResNet34UNet reconstructs identically with in_channels=2, num_classes=1, adaptation_method='slice_variance_scaled', yielding exactly 24,346,305 parameters.

normalization.evidence: Training-derived z-score normalization loaded directly from manifest normalization_stats (means=[-33.2331, -19.9412], stds=[6.4900, 4.5313]). Applied consistently across train, val, test.

checkpoint_save_load.evidence: Atomic writes via temporary files (*.tmp) and safe_load_checkpoint with allowlisted PyTorch globals (pathlib.WindowsPath, PosixPath, TorchVersion).

resume_behavior.evidence: Automatic resume from latest_checkpoint.pt or explicit --resume <path>. Re-validates manifest SHA-256 against saved checkpoint fingerprint and restores optimizer/scheduler/scaler states.

single_gpu_execution.evidence: --device cuda targets primary GPU device (cuda:0). Fully tested on RTX 3050 and qualified on Kaggle Tesla T4.

amp_configuration.evidence: CUDA FP16 automatic mixed precision enabled by default via torch.amp.autocast('cuda') and GradScaler('cuda'). Tested with finite gradients.

logging_run_state_telemetry.evidence: run_state.json emits real-time heartbeat and phase transitions. history.json flushes atomically per epoch. progress.log streams unbuffered UTC timestamps. run.lock prevents duplicate executions.

open_items.description: ImageNet pretrained weights (ResNet34_Weights.DEFAULT) are fetched from PyTorch hub. If Kaggle internet access is disabled, torch.hub download fails. Requires internet enabled in kernel settings OR offline weights dataset mounted.
open_items.mitigation: Enable 'Internet: On' in Kaggle kernel metadata, or upload resnet34-b627a593.pth as an auxiliary dataset.

open_items.description: Kaggle execution requires pushing source code (src/ocean_sentinel and scripts/train_exp01.py).
open_items.mitigation: Package codebase into a wheel or push directly via kaggle kernels push as demonstrated in Gate 4.2P.

open_items.description: Kaggle provides 2x Tesla T4 GPUs when GPU accelerator is enabled. Current train_exp01.py executes on single GPU (cuda:0).
open_items.mitigation: Single-GPU execution is scientifically faithful to the certified EXP01 Rev B baseline. Multi-GPU DDP is not required for EXP01 reproduction.

open_items.description: Kaggle sessions have a hard 9-hour limit and may disconnect. Output files in /kaggle/working are only saved permanently if the kernel finishes cleanly or checkpoints are committed.
open_items.mitigation: Run training in headless batch kernel mode (kaggle kernels push) so /kaggle/working artifacts are preserved upon completion.
